scheme_name: Varnam Scheme For Transgender Students Pursuing Distance Education Courses
other_conditions: Applicant must be a native and resident of Kerala
Student must be pursuing Degree/Diploma/PG courses through distance education from open universities, distance education mode, or private registration
benefits_summary: Up to ₹24,000 per year is provided, for up to 2 years for PG courses and up to 3 years for undergraduate courses
